description: Fictional checkout and payments SaaS for mid-market e-commerce brands. Register maintained by Legal; last reviewed 2026-10-15.

claims.approved_wording: Up to 30% faster checkout, based on Brightcart internal tests (2026).
claims.conditions: Must include 'up to' and the footnote source.

claims.approved_wording: Merchants saw an average 8% lift in checkout conversion after switching to Brightcart.
claims.conditions: Always state 'average' and '8%'. Never round up.

claims.approved_wording: Brightcart is PCI DSS Level 1 certified.
claims.evidence: PCI DSS v4.0 Attestation of Compliance, valid to 2027-03

claims.approved_wording: Brightcart supports more than 40 payment methods across 25 countries.
Brightcart targets 99.95% uptime under its standard SLA.
claims.conditions: 99.99% is the Enterprise SLA only and may not be used in general marketing.
claims.evidence: Standard SLA v3; Enterprise SLA v3

claims.approved_wording: Brightcart helps reduce fraudulent transactions with built-in risk scoring.
claims.conditions: Never claim fraud is eliminated or prevented entirely.

claims.approved_wording: Trusted by more than 500 e-commerce brands.
claims.conditions: Only 'more than 500'. Do not name customers without written consent.

claims.approved_wording: Brightcart offers a native integration with Optimizely Commerce.

claims.claim: Brightcart cuts cart abandonment in half
claims.approved_wording: Brightcart's one-page checkout is designed to reduce cart abandonment.
claims.conditions: No numeric claim on abandonment is substantiated.

claims.approved_wording: Most merchants go live in under two weeks.
claims.conditions: 'One day' applies only to the Shopify plugin and must say so.
